headline: Regis end Seattle Pacific's winning run
dek: Seattle Pacific lose on their own ground to a Rocky Mountain Athletic Conference side and now stand at seventeen wins, one draw and four defeats. Regis had already beaten them at home earlier in the season.
displaced_by: results night: Regis win at Seattle Pacific and end their winning run
